# stripe_tax_settings (Data Source)

The account's Stripe Tax settings: defaults, head office and status. It has no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_tax_settings" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `defaults` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--defaults))
- `head_office` (Attributes) The place where your business is located. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--head_office))
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `status` (String) Whether these settings have the information Stripe Tax needs to calculate tax. It doesn't reflect whether your integration is ready to collect tax. Possible values: `active`, `pending`.
- `status_details` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_details))

<a id="nestedatt--defaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `defaults`

Read-Only:

- `provider` (String) The tax calculation provider this account uses. Defaults to `stripe` when not using a [third-party provider](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/third-party-apps). Possible values: `anrok`, `avalara`, `sphere`, `stripe`.
- `tax_behavior` (String) Default [tax behavior](https://stripe.com/docs/tax/products-prices-tax-categories-tax-behavior#tax-behavior) used to specify whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. If the item's price has a tax behavior set, it will take precedence over the default tax behavior. Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`, `inferred_by_currency`.
- `tax_code` (String) Default [tax code](https://stripe.com/docs/tax/tax-categories) used to classify your products and prices.


<a id="nestedatt--head_office"></a>
### Nested Schema for `head_office`

Read-Only:

- `address` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--head_office--address))

<a id="nestedatt--head_office--address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `head_office.address`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City, district, suburb, town, or village.
- `country` (String) Two-letter country code ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)).
- `line1` (String) Address line 1, such as the street, PO Box, or company name.
- `line2` (String) Address line 2, such as the apartment, suite, unit, or building.
- `postal_code` (String) ZIP or postal code.
- `state` (String) State, county, province, or region ([ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2)).



<a id="nestedatt--status_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_details`

Read-Only:

- `pending` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_details--pending))

<a id="nestedatt--status_details--pending"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_details.pending`

Read-Only:

- `missing_fields` (List of String) The list of missing fields that are required to perform calculations. It includes the entry `head_office` when the status is `pending`. It is recommended to set the optional values even if they aren't listed as required for calculating taxes. Calculations can fail if missing fields aren't explicitly provided on every call.
